plan: Full design submitted with sections 1–10. (1) RQ + H1 (C4 beats C1/C2 on forecasting gap-to-oracle) and H2 (C4 beats C3 under multi-seasonality), plus identification-accuracy diagnostic, and a one-paragraph formal justification of peaking at integer multiples of L. (2) Datasets table: 4 synthetic families at SNR ∈ {5, 1, 0.2} with L_true ∈ {12,24,48,72,96,168,720}, plus 4 real benchmarks ETTh1/ETTh2/Weather/Traffic with documented expected period and split policy. (3) ACF pipeline pseudocode covering ADF pre-test → seasonal differencing regime flag → per-channel ACF → Bonferroni-corrected variance-weighted pooling → peak selectors argmax/lowest-significant-peak/cumulative-harmonic/prominence-strict → tie-break (sharper margin → smaller L → domain default). (4) CycleNet-replica: 2-layer MLP + RPL head with learnable periodic embedding indexed by t mod L; AdamW lr 1e-3, cos, batch 256, early-stop on val MSE; lookback {96,336} × horizon {96,192,336,720} × 3 seeds. (5) L_cand = sorted unique G ∪ A with M=25 cap and documented pruning rule; fallback M=12. (6) Eight selectors C0 Oracle, C1 Default (L=24), C2 Random, C3 Argmax, **C4 Lowest-significant-peak (proposed primary)**, C5 Cumulative-harmonic, C6 Prominence-strict, C7 Grid-search-best. (7) Metrics: MSE/MAE per horizon, paired-difference tables, Wilcoxon across 4 datasets × 4 horizons × 3 seeds, identification Top-1 / ±1 tolerance on synthetics, agreement-vs-C7 on real. (8) Analysis plan P1 (headline Δ_MSE between C4 and C1/C2), P2 (paired-difference C4 vs C3/C5/C6), P3 (subgroup H2 on SYN-S2 and Traffic), S1 (synthetic identification), S2 (ablation of pooling/differencing/tie-break). (9) Feasibility: scientific Python (numpy/scipy/statsmodels/pandas) plus PyTorch CPU if present; sweep ≤25 L × 4 real × 4 horizons × 3 seeds = 1200 + 10 synth × 25 L × 3 seeds = 750; compressed-grid 12-L fallback documented; explicit declaration that only a CycleNet-replica is used (no official codebase execution). (10) Risks & limitations: pooling assumption B1 depends on a shared-L semantic; multi-seasonal series can break lowest-peak uniqueness (mitigated by C5); ADF/seasonal-differencing introduces a regime flag; block-bootstrap left as upgrade path; identifiability gap on real (no oracle)→ reference is C7; no GPU and no preinstalled deps constrain lookback × horizon × seed; repository contains no CycleNet code, so all parameter semantics derive from the published paper. Every numerical claim tagged [Setup] vs [Anticipated outcome] with the analysis-plan step that yields it.
